scope: QuickJS and JSC shared-group guests on bunwasm-host and the Browser host (browser-guest.ts)
note: Native reference control uses index.ts. The blocking shared-profile consumer runs two commands, each once and each with its own expected output: cmd (expected.txt), including the explicit mixed-backend rejection, and cmd.lifetime (expected.lifetime.txt), the 200-worker lane lifetime run followed by a fresh guest. No missing artifact or capability is a passing skip.
